name: Shoujo Enkou
source:
While skipping work one day, a guy looked for friendship on a casual dating site.
He had little experience with this and found it awkward.
Then he connected with a cute girl named "Mia".

It was agreed to meet up -- no sex -- and see how things went.
The date was fun, but Mia gave herself a stomach ache eating too much cold food.

"Let's take a rest over there."

Over there was actually a love hotel......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE149874.html]DLsite English[/url]]
